name: Infra Auto‑Remediation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      alert_id:
        description: 'OpsGenie Alert ID'
        required: true
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [infra-alert]

env:
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  rate_limit_check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      allowed: ${{ steps.check.outputs.allowed }}
    steps:
      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Check rate limits
        id: check
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          owner="${{ github.repository_owner }}"
          repo="${{ github.event.repository.name }}"
          workflow_file="infra-auto-remediation.yml"
          now=$(date +%s)

          # Fetch recent workflow runs
          api_url="https://api.github.com/repos/${owner}/${repo}/actions/runs?per_page=100&workflow_id=${workflow_file}"
          echo "Fetching workflow runs from ${api_url}"
          resp=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${GH_TOKEN}" "${api_url}")

          # Get the most recent run time
          last_run_time=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.workflow_runs[0].created_at' | xargs -I{} date -d {} +%s)

          # 5‑minute cooldown
          diff=$((now - last_run_time))
          if [ "$diff" -lt 300 ]; then
            echo "Last run was $diff seconds ago – within 5‑minute cooldown. Skipping."
            echo "allowed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi

          # Count runs in the last hour
          count=$(echo "$resp" | jq --argjson now "$now" '
            .workflow_runs[]
            | select(.created_at | fromdateiso8601 >= ($now - 3600))
            | length
            ' | wc -l)

          if [ "$count" -ge 10 ]; then
            echo "Run count in last hour: $count – exceeding 10/hour cap."
            # Create a human‑intervention issue
            gh issue create \
              --title "Infra Auto‑Remediation: Needs Human Intervention" \
              --body "Rate limit exceeded: ${count} runs in the last hour." \
              --label "needs-human"
            echo "allowed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "allowed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  investigate:
    needs: rate_limit_check
    if: needs.rate_limit_check.outputs.allowed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: infra
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Fetch OpsGenie alert details
        id: alert
        env:
          OPSGENIE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPSGENIE_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Determine alert ID from event payload or workflow_dispatch input
          alert_id="${{ github.event.client_payload.alert_id || github.event.inputs.alert_id }}"
          if [ -z "$alert_id" ]; then
            echo "❌ No alert_id provided."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Fetching OpsGenie alert ${alert_id}..."
          resp=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: GenieKey ${OPSGENIE_API_KEY}" \
            "https://api.opsgenie.com/v2/alerts/${alert_id}")
          echo "$resp" > alert.json
          echo "alert_id=${alert_id}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "alert_json=$(cat alert.json | jq -c .)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run Redis health check
        run: |
          bash scripts/redis-health.sh

      - name: Check PostgreSQL connectivity
        env:
          PGHOST: ${{ secrets.PG_HOST }}
          PGUSER: ${{ secrets.PG_USER }}
          PGPASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PG_PASSWORD }}
          PGDATABASE: ${{ secrets.PG_DB }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          psql -h "$PGHOST" -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDATABASE" -c "SELECT 1;" || echo "❌ PostgreSQL connectivity failed."

      - name: Post findings to Discord
        env:
          DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          findings=$(cat alert.json | jq -r '.data.title, .data.description')
          payload=$(jq -n --arg content "Infra Alert Investigation: ${{ steps.alert.outputs.alert_id }}\n$findings" '{content: $content}')
          curl -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$payload" "$DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"
